name: Teledirect (Partner)
desc:
(Evergreen) Customer Service Representative | Est. $17.00/hr | High Volume Inbound Phone, Multiple Clients
 https://app.teledirect.com/application/applicationremote.asp
Company: TeleDirect
 Industry: BPO | Multiple Industries

What Your Day Will Look Like:
 TeleDirect is a Business Process Outsourcer headquartered in Sacramento, California, with over 60 years in the call center industry. This role answers inbound calls for a variety of clients across different industries, which means your calls could include taking reservations, setting appointments, processing donations, and handling general customer inquiries, all depending on which client account you are assigned to.
 Key responsibilities from the posting:
Handle inbound calls for multiple clients across a variety of account types
Take reservations, set appointments, process donations, and respond to general inquiries based on client needs
Maintain proficiency in spelling, grammar, and professional communication
Contribute ideas for improving account quality and client satisfaction
Meet attendance and scheduling requirements consistently
Because TeleDirect serves multiple clients, the specific work you do daily depends on which account you are assigned. This variety can make the role engaging, though it also means adapting to different client processes and requirements over time.
assessment: Yes, confirmed in posting. After submitting the application, participants complete aptitude assessments that must be done on a computer, not a phone or tablet. Proper grammar is specifically called out as a key focus of the assessment process.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma required.
 Required Experience: 1 year of customer service experience required. Prior work-from-home experience is helpful but not required.
 Preferred Experience: Prior remote work experience. Moderate technical internet browsing proficiency. Data entry background.
 Required Skills:
Proficient spelling and grammar, specifically called out as very important in the posting
Patience and ability to accept constructive feedback
Good attendance
Must be at least 18 years old
Must be able to pass a background check and possible drug screen and have own equipment. 
"BYOE"
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who wants a flexible part-time or full-time schedule and is comfortable adapting to different client accounts over time
Participants who enjoy variety in their daily calls rather than a single-client, single-topic environment
People who meet or can readily meet the home equipment requirements, since the participant provides their own setup
Anyone with at least a year of customer service experience looking for a stable, long-established remote employer
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who does not own qualifying equipment or cannot afford to purchase it, since TeleDirect does not provide it
Participants who prefer a single, consistent type of call work rather than adapting across multiple client accounts
Anyone who cannot be available within the 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM Central window for shift assignments
Participants without a Windows 10 or 11 computer. Chromebooks are explicitly excluded
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Inbound customer service
Multi-client call center
Reservation taking
Appointment setting
Donation processing
Remote call center
BPO customer service
Professional phone communication
Grammar and written communication
Customer satisfaction
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Apply by emailing Sandra Coggeshall at sandrac@teledirect.com. After applying, complete aptitude assessments on a computer only, not a phone or tablet. The overall process takes about one week. Interviews are described as straightforward and easy, covering basic background questions. Grammar and spelling are evaluated as part of the assessment before the interview stage.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you handled a high volume of calls while maintaining quality and professionalism.
How do you adapt quickly when you are switched to a new client account with different processes and requirements?
Describe a time you received constructive feedback and how you applied it.
How do you manage your focus and energy when calls are continuous with no break between them?
other:
Equipment not provided. Participant must supply their own equipment meeting specific requirements listed in the posting, including a Windows 10 or 11 computer no older than 2 years, 8GB RAM, 250GB hard drive, USB headset with inline mute, camera, and Ethernet cable. Chromebooks and VPNs are not allowed

The application process routes directly through a recruiter email rather than a standard ATS portal. Participants should apply from a computer and be ready to complete grammar and aptitude assessments immediately after submitting. Assessments cannot be done on a phone or tablet.
The equipment requirement is real and falls entirely on the participant. Before referring anyone here, confirm they own a qualifying Windows 10 or 11 computer no older than two years, a USB headset with inline mute, and the ability to hardwire to their router via Ethernet. This is not a bring-your-own-device suggestion, it is a stated requirement for the job.

Calls are back-to-back with no buffer time between them. This is worth a direct conversation with participants who may underestimate the pace of a BPO call center environment.
Career Pathway: Customer Service Representative → Senior CSR → Team Lead → Quality Assurance Analyst → Operations Supervisor
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
